record.paper_title: Some open problems in low dimensional dynamical systems
record.original_question: Assume the origin is an isolated equilibrium point of the planar vector field defined by ẋ = 2^n Re((∂^n f/∂z̄^n)(x,y)) and ẏ = 2^n Im((∂^n f/∂z̄^n)(x,y)), where f is analytic at the origin. Determine whether the index of this vector field at the origin is always at most n.

evidence.quote: Problem 25 (Loewner’s conjecture). Assume that the origin is an isolated equilibrium point of the diﬀerential equation (20) and that f is analytic at this point. Then the index of the associated vector ﬁeld at the origin is is not greater than n.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f$ be a real-valued function of two real variables $x,y$ that is real-analytic in a neighborhood of the origin. Using the Wirtinger derivative $\partial/\partial\bar z = \tfrac12(\partial/\partial x + i\,\partial/\partial y)$ with $z = x + iy$, define for a fixed positive integer $n$ the planar vector field
$$\dot x = 2^n\,\operatorname{Re}\!\left(\frac{\partial^n f}{\partial \bar z^{\,n}}(x,y)\right), \qquad \dot y = 2^n\,\operatorname{Im}\!\left(\frac{\partial^n f}{\partial \bar z^{\,n}}(x,y)\right).$$
Assume that the origin is an isolated equilibrium (zero) of this vector field. Prove or disprove: the Poincaré–Hopf index of this vector field at the origin is at most $n$.
artifact.category_tag: Loewner conjecture / index of planar vector fields
artifact.status_search_result: The statement is the classical Loewner conjecture on the index of higher-order Wirtinger-derivative vector fields. It is known to hold for n = 1, 2, 3, 4 (the cases n = 2 imply the Carathéodory conjecture on umbilic points, with proofs given by Hamburger, Bol, Klotz, Titus, and later by Ivanov for analytic surfaces). For general n it remains open, and recent work (e.g., Index formulas for higher-order Loewner vector fields, 2023) treats only special cases.

status_evidence.title: Index formulas for higher order Loewner vector fields
status_evidence.snippet: Loewner conjectured an upper bound of n for the index of the nth order Cauchy-Riemann derivative of f as a vector field; this conjecture remains open.
status_evidence.claim: Loewner's conjecture on index ≤ n of the nth Wirtinger-derivative vector field is still open in general.

status_evidence.title: A proof of a conjecture of Loewner and of the conjecture of Carathéodory on umbilic points
status_evidence.snippet: Proof of the Loewner conjecture for n = 2 and the Carathéodory conjecture on umbilic points.
status_evidence.claim: The case n = 2 has a published proof (Ivanov), establishing partial resolution.
